text:
alex: Quick sync — iterating the Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing copy before next week's launch post. Need decisions on hero angle + CTA lanes.
sophia: For hero I still prefer latency-first for Hosted ("fastest to prod"), cost predictability for Dedicated, and security/compliance for Private. Short, stacked bullets.
jamal: +1. Can we quantify? e.g., 'sub-100ms per token' for Hosted benchmarks — but only if we have a verified test.
emily: We have recent internal bench: avg token latency 82ms for short chats on hosted-g4. I'll add a precise line to the benchmarks doc and ping eng to confirm.
carla: For CTAs — propose 3 lanes on each page: Start free (self-serve), Book a dedicated demo, Enterprise paperwork (Private). Routing rules: self-serve -> marketing automation, demo -> SDR queue, enterprise -> AE+solutions.
alex: Perfect. Jamal, any preference on phrasing for Dedicated? "Predictable capacity, predictable cost" vs "Reserved GPUs for steady throughput"?
jamal: Lean toward the first — resonates with platform buyers. Maybe: "Reserved capacity with SLA-backed throughput". Short phrase, trust signal.
sophia: Webinar idea: run a parallel bench walkthrough + customer case study titled "Serving LLMs at scale: latency, cost, and fallbacks". Use the landing pages to drive signups.
emily: I'll coordinate with ops to get the bench slides + a 3-min demo snippet. We should ask speakers to call out quantization tradeoffs and autoscaling.
carla: Inbound routing detail: capture two hidden fields in the signup form: "expected monthly tokens" and "deployment mode interest" (hosted/dedicated/private). Use that for lead scoring.
jamal: Good — also add a checkbox: "Need compliance review" to flag Private leads.
alex: Copy note: avoid jargon like "KV cache" on the landing hero — keep it benefits-first. Technical details belong on the benchmarks and deep-dive pages.
sophia: For the three-mode nav, maybe a single hero with micro-tabs: Hosted | Dedicated | Private — hero sentence swaps but same visual. Keeps SEO consolidated.
emily: Mockups incoming. I'll wire the micro-tabs and CMS variants.
carla: A/B test CTAs this week: 'Start free' vs 'See pricing' for Hosted — measure conversion to API key.
jamal: Add analytics event for 'benchmarks pdf download' so we can tie signups to bench consumption.
marketing-bot: Reminder: marketing sprint demo tomorrow 11am — drop final copy into /campaigns/tri-mode-landing by EOD today.
alex: Thanks — I'll consolidate copy edits into one doc and tag you all. Small ask: keep hero under 12 words if possible.
sophia: On it. I'll send one-liners in the doc now. :thumbsup:
